name: io.github.Ryhus/anki-mcp
title: Anki MCP
description: Manage local Anki notes, cards, decks, note types, media, and deck packages via AnkiConnect.

environmentVariables.name: ANKI_URL
environmentVariables.description: AnkiConnect base URL on your computer. Keep Anki Desktop open; omit /api/v1.

environmentVariables.name: ANKI_API_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Use v1 for the full tool set with compatible AnkiConnect, or legacy for older add-ons.

environmentVariables.name: ANKI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Request deadline in integer milliseconds, including queue wait: 1 to 300000.

environmentVariables.name: ANKI_MEDIA_IMPORT_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Optional trusted local media folders. Separate with : on macOS/Linux or ; on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: ANKI_PACKAGE_IMPORT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional existing absolute folder for local .apkg imports. Requires API v1.

environmentVariables.name: ANKI_PACKAGE_EXPORT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional existing absolute folder for local .apkg exports. Requires API v1.
